(1) the quality of the annotations produced by TTCS is high; (2) TTCS can be used to extract common-sense conceptual representations of terms and their contexts; (3) these representations can be used to improve the performances of a semantic categorization system.

(i) TTCS is able to extract conceptual information that is coherent with human judgments and that (ii) the conceptual categorization system performs significantly better when it is fed with extracted conceptual annotations rather than with hand-crafted ones.
